children: ASML Holding NV Sponsored ADR (EURONEXT:ASML) is seeing near-term EUV capacity fully booked through 2027 and multi‑year AI chip orders, buybacks and a major Brainport campus buildout underpin growth as analysts eye a path toward a potential $1T valuation despite China export risks.
: ASML says nearly all EUV tool capacity is booked through end-2027, with orders from TSMC, Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron and Intel tied to multi-year AI chip demand.
ASML Priced In China Risk, Trump-Xi Meeting Watch
: UBS says ASML (ASML) already prices in much China export‑restriction risk; traders watch the near‑term Trump‑Xi meeting as a key event for the stock.
: ASML reported share repurchases under its Jan 28, 2026 buyback program, disclosing the timing and activity of repurchases to meet Market Abuse Regulation reporting rules.
: PitchBook projects ASML could hit $1 trillion market cap by 2028–2031; market cap was about $257.9B in 2025. Arm named ASML’s main rival for that milestone.
: ASML (ASML) started building Brainport Industries Campus North in Eindhoven on Sept 8, 2026. Project spans ~350,000 m² and could support up to 20,000 jobs — key for capacity and local hiring.
